project_name: Universal QR Collections - Indian Distribution Billing MVP
archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast Performance Pro (Fintech POS & Billing Counter)

typography.pairing_strategy: The Swiss Utility (Display Sans + Tech Mono)
rules: DO NOT use Inter or Space Grotesk for Headings.
Always use JetBrains Mono for INR monetary amounts, UPI IDs, Razorpay QR IDs, Invoice Reference numbers, and Timestamps.
Headings over 24px must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).

billing_counter_screen.optimization: Large touch targets (min 48px height for inputs/buttons), split-screen visual feedback layout for tablet/desktop.
billing_counter_screen.left_panel: Fast payment generator form with quick preset buttons (₹100, ₹500, ₹1000, ₹5000, Custom), Amount INR, Invoice/Ref, Customer Name, Notes.
billing_counter_screen.right_panel: Spacious QR presentation viewport with real-time status polling, live payment notification sound simulation, URL copy, PNG download, and test-mode notice banner.

dashboard_grid.mode: MODE B: High Density Grid (4-column layout)
cards: Main Section: Recent Payment Activity (Dense tabular display with real-time updates)

test_mode_notice_banner.style: bg-amber-500/10 border-l-4 border-amber-500 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300 p-4 rounded-r-lg shadow-sm font-medium text-sm flex items-center gap-3
test_mode_notice_banner.text: NOTICE: Razorpay Test Mode active. Generated QR codes are for testing workflow integration and will not process real bank money transfers.

component_guidelines.toast_notifications: Use Sonner for toasts (copied to clipboard, QR generated, payment received, user deactivated).
component_guidelines.modal_and_dialogs: Use customized Shadcn Dialogs with crisp semi-transparent borders and subtle dark backdrops.
component_guidelines.tables: Searchable, filterable by payment status and date range, zebra-striped subtle hover effects, formatted dates and currency.
component_guidelines.qr_display: High contrast black-on-white QR canvas container with rounded corners, download image button, copy payment link button, and clear expiration/status countdown.

testing_attributes.requirement: ALL interactive components (inputs, buttons, status badges, rows, tabs, toggles) MUST include explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow this design guideline strictly when implementing components.
Ensure dark mode and light mode toggle works smoothly and defaults to dark mode.
Make billing counter QR generation screen touch-friendly with minimum 48px height on touch buttons and inputs for tablet use.
Ensure polling logic works for QR payment status updates in QR detail and billing screens.
Always render the Razorpay test-mode notice banner visibly on QR generation and QR detail screens.
Include high-contrast payment status chips for PAID, PENDING, FAILED, and EXPIRED statuses.
Attach data-testid attributes to all form inputs, buttons, table rows, and status badges.
